correctness.rationale: The 12-vertex 30-edge graph is defined by actual adjacency lists. In every one of its 4096 vertex masks, degree-at-most-one equals induced-component-size-at-most-two, validating dissociation/Ind₂ equivalence. Independent enumeration yields 323 nonempty faces f=(12,66,140,105), all 105 facets tetrahedra, and a 151-pair Morse matching with one critical 0-cell and twenty critical 3-cells. All 972 nonempty cover incidences form an acyclic oriented graph (984 incidences if twelve empty-to-singleton covers are counted). Forman then gives an integral wedge of twenty S³. Independently generated 60 rotations, a central antipodal involution, and 120 full automorphisms; oriented simplex Lefschetz traces agree with rotations of orders (1,2,3,5) giving (20,4,-1,0) and antipodally twisted (10,2,1,0). Decomposing the even/odd A5 characters yields 1⁺ ⊕ 4⁺ ⊕ 2·5⁺ ⊕ 5⁻ over Q. No integral equivariant lattice assertion.

originality.rationale: This is second independence / dissociation / induced-component-size-two complex, not the ordinary independence, matching, neighborhood, or metric complex of the same icosahedron. Full primary Deshpande–Singh higher-independence paper lists complete multipartite, whiskered, paths/cycles and rooted/perfect tree cases, not icosahedral five-regular graph. Abdelmalek et al chordal arguments do not apply since every icosahedral vertex neighborhood is an induced five-cycle. Published icosahedral neighborhood and Rips A5×C2 characters refer to different face sets. Orlovich et al 2011 dissociation primary full text not read; indexed abstract centers optimization rather than topological characters. Best-of-knowledge priority qualified.

value.rationale: Dissociation is a classical graph invariant and the regular icosahedron is a canonical highly symmetric planar triangulation. An exact integral homotopy wedge plus the full rational A5×C2 action—including antipodal parity and invariant dimension—supplies intrinsic structure beyond counts and general connectivity estimates for higher independence complexes.
